question.text: The abbreviated bid-offer price for USD/JPY is 115.55/57. What is the full offer price?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per page 23, USDJPY 115.55/115.57 is abbreviated as 115.55/57, so the full offer is 115.57. Page 22 explains that two-decimal currency pairs quote the offer in two decimal places. The Trap: 115.55 is the bid, not the offer. In abbreviated form only the offer side is shortened. Note: Page 22 also notes that EURUSD and GBPUSD may be quoted to five decimals in some markets, so the abbreviation convention depends on the pair.
